device_visible_states.name: Attached
device_visible_states.description: Device powered (VBUS), but not yet seen by host (D± pull-up not yet asserted).

device_visible_states.name: Powered
device_visible_states.description: Device asserts speed-identification pull-up; host detects connect.

device_visible_states.name: Default
device_visible_states.description: After USB Reset; device responds to address 0.

device_visible_states.name: Address
device_visible_states.description: Device has been assigned a unique 7-bit address (1..127) via SET_ADDRESS request.

device_visible_states.name: Configured
device_visible_states.description: Device has accepted a SET_CONFIGURATION request with a non-zero configuration value; endpoints other than EP0 are usable.

device_visible_states.name: Suspended
device_visible_states.description: Bus idle > 3 ms; device must reduce VBUS current to ≤ 500 µA.

fsm_hints.host_role: All transactions initiated by the host. Periodic transactions (Interrupt / Isochronous) scheduled by the host on a per-(micro)frame basis.
fsm_hints.device_role: Devices are addressable + polled targets — they may NAK if not ready but cannot initiate non-SOF traffic (except remote wakeup K-state from Suspend).
fsm_hints.rule: Each transaction = Token + (optional Data) + (optional Handshake). DATA toggle bit synchronizes endpoint between host and device across retries.

anti_deadlock_rule: Host controller maintains separate periodic + asynchronous schedules; isochronous + interrupt scheduled first per microframe with budget guarantees; bulk + control fill remaining time. Hub-based forwarding has fixed worst-case turn-around timing.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: Default state at attach; host detects connect, drives Reset SE0 ≥ 10 ms, optionally chirps for HS negotiation, then enumerates: GET_DESCRIPTOR(Device) at address 0, SET_ADDRESS, GET_DESCRIPTOR(Configuration), SET_CONFIGURATION.

default_ready_state_recommendation.Both_low: SE0 — interpreted as Reset or End-of-Packet depending on duration.

handshake_packet_meanings.name: ACK
handshake_packet_meanings.meaning: Packet accepted without error; data successfully received.

handshake_packet_meanings.name: NAK
handshake_packet_meanings.meaning: Device not ready; host may retry later.

handshake_packet_meanings.name: STALL
handshake_packet_meanings.meaning: Endpoint is halted; host must clear ENDPOINT_HALT feature to recover.

handshake_packet_meanings.name: NYET
handshake_packet_meanings.meaning: (HS only) Data accepted, but next will likely NAK; used with PING flow control.

handshake_packet_meanings.name: NRDY
handshake_packet_meanings.meaning: (HS only) Device not ready (used in PING context).

data_toggle_rule: Endpoint maintains a toggle bit (DATA0 ↔ DATA1) per pipe; transmitter alternates after each ACKed packet; receiver only accepts the expected toggle. SETUP token always forces DATA0; STALL preserves toggle.
split_transaction_rule: USB 2.0 hub bridging HS upstream to FS/LS downstream issues Start-Split (SSPLIT) at the HS side, the hub then performs the FS/LS transaction on its own clock, and the host later issues Complete-Split (CSPLIT) to retrieve the result.
